lines.en: - You should've put it on my tray in the first place.
- You know where I want to put it right now?
- You watch your mouth before I put my fist in it!
- Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey, hey!
You say you're sorry to the customer.
- Get it, get it, get it, get it, come, come, come, come.
- Do we think you were a little rough on him?
- I'll never see you again, will I?
- Hey, why don't you help me write the web show
we're gonna have to do in here?
- Why don't you guys just hire an intern?
- Like an assistant that works for free.
- I like being clean, I just don't like all the--
- When was the last time you did laundry?
- Ah, when did I move in here?
- This is a really fun game, you guys should try it.
- Well, we need you to play a better game.
- Will you do my laundry too?
- No, Sam, I will not do your laundry.
And you got the stink out!
So many of our foods and beverages today
are sold with all kinds of needless packaging,
which ends up right in our nation's trash cans.
Well, I say, to heck with packaging!
If I'm thirsty, I can just do this.
I'm from Seattle and I love fried chicken!
- I want the leg, give me the leg.
- Oh, I love fried chicken in the morning.
- During the show, there's no wrong time to eat an egg roll.
- Do you have any pudding cups?
- Just one, and I already promised Freddy
he could have it after the show.
- Can I have a chicken puck?
- You want one of my chicken pucks?
And we got cornbread, potato doodles, oh, and for dessert,
we have make your own ice cream sundaes
with my very special strawberry gravy.
I'm just afraid I'm dreaming and...
I don't want to wake up.
Sam, this is my Uncle Barry, my Aunt Tess,
and my cousins, Oslottis and Faye.
- Uh, what's that thing around his neck?
- Oh, Oslottis has a scab on his chin.
- The cone keeps him from picking at it.
You said you'd have dinner with us.
- Yes, and then I met them.
- Shouldn't you girls be getting to class by now?
- Shouldn't you be married by now?
- Well, good to see you, Miss Briggs.
- It makes me feel sad for lesser lockers.
- Oh, I could fit a whole editing bay in there.
- You could fit a body in there.
- And remember, Mr. Blanton said we have to do it
just like an actual iCarly web show.
- Hey, hey, can I borrow 30 bucks?
I gotta pay a cab driver.
- You took a cab to school?
- My mom loaned her car to some fishermen
- A cab here from your house doesn't cost $30.
- It does if you make the guy stop
and buy you a breakfast burrito.
- The lab's a 10 and I need it.
- Hey, Keenan, I know we just met and everything,
but would you maybe wanna help us out with something?
You see that, there it is right there.
Why does everybody wanna borrow money from me?
- You cannot tell anyone about this.
- I just play a song and the machine thanks me with cash.
- I know, but I'm not sure this is legal.
- Oh, should I give this back?
- I say, we think about it
while we buy stuff at the mall!
